mapper.select: select (select count(*) from ding_tenant) as totalTenants, (select count(*) from ding_order) as totalOrders, (select count(*) from ding_subscription where status = 1 and start_time <= now() and end_time > now()) as activeSubscriptions, (select count(*) from ding_order where pay_status = 0) as pendingPayments, (select count(*) from ding_order where pay_status = 1) as paidOrders, (select coalesce(sum(pay_amount), 0) from ding_order where pay_status = 1) as totalRevenue, (select count(*) from ding_order where create_time >= curdate() and create_time < date_add(curdate(), interval 1 day)) as todayOrders, (select coalesce(sum(pay_amount), 0) from ding_order where pay_status = 1 and pay_time >= curdate() and pay_time < date_add(curdate(), interval 1 day)) as todayRevenue, (select count(*) from ding_sync_log where create_time >= curdate() and create_time < date_add(curdate(), interval 1 day)) as todaySyncCount, (select count(*) from ding_sync_log where status = 1 and create_time >= curdate() and create_time < date_add(curdate(), interval 1 day)) as todaySyncSuccess

select date_format(pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(*) as orderCount, coalesce(sum(pay_amount), 0) as revenue from ding_order where pay_status = 1 and pay_time >= #{startDate} group by date_format(pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date
select order_type as type, count(*) as count from ding_order group by order_type
select pay_status as status, count(*) as count from ding_order group by pay_status

select case when pay_channel is null or pay_channel = '' then '未知' else pay_channel end as channel, count(*) as count, coalesce(sum(pay_amount), 0) as amount from ding_order where pay_status = 1 group by case when pay_channel is null or pay_channel = '' then '未知' else pay_channel end order by count desc

select case when industry is null or industry = '' then '未知' else industry end as industry, count(*) as count from ding_tenant group by case when industry is null or industry = '' then '未知' else industry end order by count desc

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(*) as totalCount, sum(case when status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as successCount, sum(case when status = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as failCount, sum(case when status = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as blockedCount, coalesce(sum(sync_count), 0) as totalSync from ding_sync_log where create_time >= #{startDate} group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date
select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(*) as count from ding_tenant where create_time >= #{startDate} group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date

select p.product_name as productName, count(o.id) as orderCount, coalesce(sum(o.pay_amount), 0) as revenue from ding_order o left join ding_product p on o.product_id = p.id where o.pay_status = 1 group by o.product_id, p.product_name order by revenue desc limit 5
